definition: to ask someone to come into a room
description: In a bright corridor used as a waiting area, a young woman in a black blazer and white top, with sunglasses on her head, leans out of an open office door holding papers and a pen, beckons with one finger and speaks. Along the wall people in mascot costumes wait on chairs: a smiling sun and a chicken. A young man in a full banana suit walks past her through the door into the office, and she steps back to let him in. A coat stand with costume heads and a water cooler stand at the end of the corridor.

taps.phrase: to hold a stack of papers

taps.target: the man in the banana suit
